notes: Official Hallandsleden page/API/GPX define current Kvarnforsen - Gyltige, 24 km. Naturkartan slug, OSM relation 5599309, Wikiloc, Pacer and Destination Halmstad preserve old Sandsjön-Kvarnforsen-Gyltige 31-32 km framing.
Official page/API display 24 km/24000 m, GPX desc says 23.5 km, computed official geometry length is 23.493 km and Naturkartan shows 23.3 km.
Current page/API classify S3 as Södra delleden, but official GPX filename/metadata begins Mellersta_Kvarnforsen_Gyltige.
Official S3 GPX first point is 162.1 m from M6 endpoint, but S3 point 4 is only 2.7 m from M6 endpoint. Naturkartan starts near this practical handoff rather than the first official point.
Official S3 page says no toilet at Gyltige; Hallandsleden Gyltige place does not confirm water/toilet; Destination Halmstad and OSM say drinking water and dry toilet/toilets exist.
Hallandsleden places API returns Hålväg and Rödek for S3, but they are far/off-route and appear to belong to S2/Gyltige-side association.
